messages:
Leah (People Ops): Quick note on final handback day prep — rolling out a few small changes to reduce last-minute churn. Please read.

Tom (Eng Manager): Short — what changed?

Leah (People Ops): 4 tweaks: 1) standardized attachment names, 2) anonymized anchors for calibration, 3) reviewer capacity flag, 4) fallback routing to senior reviewer. Details below.

Eleni (Reviewer): Attachment name format? I always forget which filename breaks import.

Leah (People Ops): Use this exact pattern: <team>-<manager>-<employee>-notes-YYYYMMDD.pdf Example: eng-platform-tom-anya-notes-20260412.pdf We will reject uploads that don't match. Keeps bulk import clean.

Tom (Eng Manager): Oof okay we'll patch our internal checklist. Any guidance on content length?

Leah (People Ops): 100-500 words recommended for manager summary. Bullet strengths/areas and one impact example. Put calibration anchors in a separate file called <team>-calibration-anchors.pdf

Sam (IC): Anonymized anchors? Why separate?

Leah (People Ops): Calibration wants blind examples so reviewers don't see names during scoring. Put 3 anonymized snippets labeled A/B/C with role context only (senior IC, mid IC, new hire). No names or team-specific details. This speeds calibration meetings.

Eleni (Reviewer): Reviewer capacity flag? How do we set that?

Leah (People Ops): New field in the reviewer roster: green/yellow/red. Green = available, Yellow = overloaded (max 6 handbacks), Red = reassign. Managers: check roster before assigning cross-team reviewers. We'll publish roster link in the console.

Tom (Eng Manager): If a reviewer is Red and we still need coverage, what's fallback?

Leah (People Ops): Fallback routing rules: first try same-band senior reviewer, then people-ops will auto-assign floating reviewers. If none available, we create a 48h extension for that employee's handback window.

HR-Helper: Reminder: Handback export opens Mon 08:00 PT. Auto-pings at 72h, 24h, 6h.

Sam (IC): I'm planning a 10-day parental leave during handback week. Do I mark myself Red?

Leah (People Ops): Yes mark Red and submit leave in Workday + add a note in the swap form. For parental/carer LOA we allow manual reassign + a 72h review extension for impacted reports.

Eleni (Reviewer): One more: how do we surface controversial ratings for calibration?

Leah (People Ops): Add a single-line rationale next to each score flagged as "disagree" in the calibration doc. We'll collect those and prioritize in the canary calibration meeting.

Tom (Eng Manager): Appreciate the clarity. Will update my team checklist and rename a few PDFs now.

Leah (People Ops): Thanks — ping me if you find any CSV import errors. We'll triage immediately.

HR-Helper: Note: All changes live in the Review Ops playbook: https://rwd.in/review-playbook (updated today).
